item.title: Vote for SAVE shows us Sen. Collins is not a moderate voice | Letter
item.description: Sen. Susan Collins has represented Maine in the U.S. Senate for nearly three decades. She often brands herself as a moderate, but her support for the SAVE Act calls that reputation into question. The SAVE Act would require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections. Supporters argue it protects election integrity. […]

item.title: Maine Celtics roll past Windy City Bulls
item.description: Keon Johnson has a double-double for Maine, and 7 Celtics reach double figures in scoring.

item.title: Southern Maine women’s basketball earns NCAA D-III tourney bid
item.description: The Huskies pull away in the 2nd half to beat Rhode Island College for their 1st Little East Conference title since 2013.

item.title: Bates women’s basketball beats Bowdoin to win NESCAC title
item.description: The second-seeded Bobcats knock off the two-time defending champs with a strong 3-point shooting performance.

item.title: Saint Joseph’s men’s basketball rolls to GNAC title

item.title: With the traditional lion dance, this family shares Chinese culture across Maine
item.description: The Wong family, of Bangor, has brought this Lunar New Year tradition across the state for decades, including to the Chinese and American Friendship Association of Maine's celebration in Westbrook on Sunday.

item.title: An unaffiliated candidate is not an independent candidate | Letter
item.description: Regarding the Feb. 21 article “Could Maine’s next governor be an independent?,” it is time we retire the outdated notion that politicians are “independent” simply because they list no party affiliation.
